Alex G: Evening handoff — quick compact notes.

Alex G: What changed since morning:
- Canary rollout for 3.2.1 finished (~15:20 UTC)
- Redis node replacement completed, cache warmed
- Small spike in short-lived 502s on /v1/generate around 15:35 (no user-facing errors)

Maya R: Thanks — did we pin model variant for canary? @Leo T

Leo T: yes, canary uses redwood/gpt-medium-quantized:v3. Confirmed pinned in rollout config.

Samir K: FYI: there is a config drift on prod-batcher (threshold: 8 -> 10) — I applied the fix, will monitor. :eyes:

Oncall Bot: deploy: 3.2.1-canary -> stable completed at 2268003600

Alex G: What to watch overnight:
- Watch 95th latency for generate across eu-west region (target <200ms)
- Monitor 502/504 rate; if >0.8% over 5m, rollback plan A
- KV cache hit rate — if <60% for >10m, check batcher logs

Maya R: Action items:
1) Leo: leave rollout pinned for 2 hours, then promote or rollback.
2) Samir: keep an eye on prod-batcher metric and patch any config flaps.
3) Alex: follow up on the small 502 spike logs tomorrow morning.

Leo T: On it. I set an alert: alert-batcher-drift (snooze 2h), and a dashboard: /dash/prod/latency-gen

Samir K: Quick note: incident runbook step for cache warm-up -> run `redis-cli --rdb-save` is outdated; see #eng-runtime PR 438

Alex G: Swap: I'm OOO tomorrow morning 08:00-12:00 UTC. Maya, can you cover the AM window? If not, ping Samir.

Maya R: I can cover AM until 10:30 UTC, then Samir covers until Alex is back. :ok_hand:

Samir K: Confirmed. I'll be oncall 10:30-12:00 UTC. Add me to the watchlist.

Oncall Bot: handoff: Alex G -> Maya R at 2268004321

Alex G: One more: PRs to watch for morning merges — #4228 (batcher threshold), #4250 (canary pin). Ping me on the PR if merging.

Maya R: Got it. I'll keep the watchlist open and leave brief notes on the bridge if anything odd.

Alex G: Thanks team — no action needed unless alerts trigger. :v:
